answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 14705 Country: United Kingdom Title: Asalamualaikum Q-Is it permissible or bidat when you meet a muslim or write a letter to say or write the word salaams for short instead of Assalamualaikum? Question: Asalamualaikum Q-Is it permissible or bidat when you meet a muslim or write a letter to say or write the word salaams for short instead of Assalamualaikum? Answer ID: 14705 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1381/1129=D/1430) Greeting with Assalamu Alaikum is sunnah, it is bad to be habitual of greeting with any other form of greeting. Saying only ?salam? is not bid?ah (innovation) rather it is against sunnah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
